title.narrative: Construction of the Magbele and Mabang Bridges

description.narrative: Contract related to: Construction of the Magbele and Mabang Bridges - The project aims at uplifting and improving the road communication system between Moyamba city and the Masiaka-Bo highway. Access to the South-Eastern part of the country will be facilitated with subsequent improvement of the economical and social conditions in the whole district. The uplifting of the A class road network includes both road and bridge works.
